env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd twin
logos run .
! stdout 'FAIL'
cp stdout ../twin.txt
cd ..

cd x
logos run .
! stdout 'FAIL'
cmp stdout ../twin.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../../twin.txt
cd ../..

-- twin/go.mod --
module example.com/twin

go 1.27

-- twin/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Left[T any] struct{ V T }

type Right[T any] struct{ V T }

func (l Left[T]) Name() string { return "left" }

func (r Right[T]) Name() string { return "right" }

type Pair[T any] interface {
	Left[T] | Right[T]
	Name() string
}

type Link[T any] interface {
	*T | string
}

type Seq[T any] interface {
	[]T | int
}

func PickPair[T any](i int, v T) Pair[T]? {
	switch i {
	case 0:
		return Pair[T](Left[T]{V: v})
	case 1:
		return Pair[T](Right[T]{V: v})
	}
	return nil
}

func DescribePair[T any](p Pair[T]?) string {
	if p != nil {
		return p.Name()
	}
	return "absent"
}

func FindLink(ok bool) Link[int]? {
	if ok {
		return Link[int]("linked")
	}
	return nil
}

func FindSeq(ok bool) Seq[int]? {
	if ok {
		return Seq[int]([]int(nil))
	}
	return nil
}

func report(name string, ok bool) {
	if ok {
		fmt.Println("ok", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
}

func main() {
	report("pair-left", DescribePair[int](PickPair(0, 1)) == "left")
	report("pair-right", DescribePair[int](PickPair(1, 1)) == "right")
	report("pair-absent", DescribePair[int](PickPair(2, 1)) == "absent")
	report("pair-nil", PickPair(2, "s") == nil)
	report("pair-present", PickPair(0, "s") != nil)
	var local Pair[string]? = nil
	report("pair-local-absent", DescribePair[string](local) == "absent")
	local = Pair[string](Left[string]{V: "x"})
	report("pair-local-member", DescribePair[string](local) == "left")
	report("link-present", FindLink(true) != nil)
	report("link-absent", FindLink(false) == nil)
	report("link-coalesce", fmt.Sprint(FindLink(false) ?? Link[int]("none")) == "none")
	report("seq-present-nil", FindSeq(true) != nil)
	report("seq-absent", FindSeq(false) == nil)
}

-- x/go.mod --
module example.com/ord

go 1.27

-- x/exp/exp.lgo --
package exp

type Left[T any] struct{ V T }

type Right[T any] struct{ V T }

func (l Left[T]) Name() string { return "left" }

func (r Right[T]) Name() string { return "right" }

type Pair[T any] interface {
	Left[T] | Right[T]
	Name() string
}

type Link[T any] interface {
	*T | string
}

type Seq[T any] interface {
	[]T | int
}

func PickPair[T any](i int, v T) Pair[T]? {
	switch i {
	case 0:
		return Pair[T](Left[T]{V: v})
	case 1:
		return Pair[T](Right[T]{V: v})
	}
	return nil
}

func DescribePair[T any](p Pair[T]?) string {
	if p != nil {
		return p.Name()
	}
	return "absent"
}

func FindLink(ok bool) Link[int]? {
	if ok {
		return Link[int]("linked")
	}
	return nil
}

func FindSeq(ok bool) Seq[int]? {
	if ok {
		return Seq[int]([]int(nil))
	}
	return nil
}

-- x/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	a "example.com/ord/exp"
)

func report(name string, ok bool) {
	if ok {
		fmt.Println("ok", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
}

func main() {
	report("pair-left", a.DescribePair[int](a.PickPair(0, 1)) == "left")
	report("pair-right", a.DescribePair[int](a.PickPair(1, 1)) == "right")
	report("pair-absent", a.DescribePair[int](a.PickPair(2, 1)) == "absent")
	report("pair-nil", a.PickPair(2, "s") == nil)
	report("pair-present", a.PickPair(0, "s") != nil)
	var local a.Pair[string]? = nil
	report("pair-local-absent", a.DescribePair[string](local) == "absent")
	local = a.Pair[string](a.Left[string]{V: "x"})
	report("pair-local-member", a.DescribePair[string](local) == "left")
	report("link-present", a.FindLink(true) != nil)
	report("link-absent", a.FindLink(false) == nil)
	report("link-coalesce", fmt.Sprint(a.FindLink(false) ?? a.Link[int]("none")) == "none")
	report("seq-present-nil", a.FindSeq(true) != nil)
	report("seq-absent", a.FindSeq(false) == nil)
}
